User Story: As a doctor, I want to log in with my credentials so I can access the doctor dashboard.
Definition of Done: Login endpoint returns role and profile, UI routes correctly, tests pass.

User Story: As a receptionist, I want to log in and view receptionist tools so I can manage daily operations.
Definition of Done: Receptionist login flow works on device and web.

User Story: As a receptionist, I want to create a patient record so that appointments can be booked.
Definition of Done: Patient appears in API and directory screen.

User Story: As clinic staff, I want to edit patient demographics and notes so records stay accurate.
Definition of Done: PATCH/update_info works and UI updates.

User Story: As a receptionist, I want to book an appointment with date/time and doctor so patient visits are scheduled.
Definition of Done: Booking endpoint and calendar views validated.

User Story: As a doctor, I want appointment filtering by date so I can review my workload.
Definition of Done: Filter parameters return correct subset.

User Story: As a doctor, I want to save diagnosis and medications so treatment history is preserved.
Definition of Done: MedicalRecord and Prescription records are created.

User Story: As a doctor, I want medication suggestions so I can prescribe faster.
Definition of Done: Suggest endpoint returns relevant medications.

User Story: As a receptionist, I want to manage insurance companies so billing rules are consistent.
Definition of Done: Insurance CRUD endpoints connected to UI.

User Story: As billing staff, I want insurance validity dates enforced so expired policies are not applied.
Definition of Done: Invoice logic ignores expired insurance and tests pass.

User Story: As a receptionist, I want to create invoices with multiple items so payment collection is accurate.
Definition of Done: Invoice totals are computed and visible.

User Story: As a receptionist, I want to mark invoices as paid so payment status is tracked.
Definition of Done: mark_paid endpoint updates payment state.

User Story: As clinic staff, I want to add and edit inventory items so stock records stay current.
Definition of Done: Inventory CRUD works with form validation.

User Story: As clinic staff, I want to add and consume stock with transaction logs so usage is auditable.
Definition of Done: add_stock/use_stock endpoints create transactions.

User Story: As clinic manager, I want low-stock and expiring-soon alerts so I can restock proactively.
Definition of Done: Alert endpoints return correct items.

User Story: As clinic manager, I want analytics charts so I can monitor clinic performance.
Definition of Done: Reports endpoints and report pages render data.

User Story: As a receptionist, I want to configure clinic schedule so booking follows business hours.
Definition of Done: upsert/resolved schedule endpoints validated.

User Story: As the team, we want CI checks so regressions are detected automatically.
Definition of Done: CI workflow runs tests and lint on push/PR.

User Story: As the team, we want automated CD so master deploys reliably.
Definition of Done: CD workflow triggers hosting deployment via hooks.

User Story: As project evaluators, we need complete Phase 2 docs so the system is assessable.
Definition of Done: Test cases, diagrams, requirements, and scrum artifacts completed.
